title: IEC 62304: medical device software life cycle (Class C)
text: Insulin pump firmware is software safety Class C (death or serious injury possible). Class C requires software requirements traced to risk controls, detailed design, unit implementation and verification, integration and system testing, regression testing after every change, configuration management and a problem resolution process. Every change needs a change request, impact analysis on existing risk controls and re-verification evidence.

title: ISO 14971: risk management for medical devices
text: Identify hazards and hazardous situations, estimate and evaluate risk, implement risk control measures, verify that each control is implemented and effective, and evaluate residual risk. A software change that touches a risk control (a dose limit, a lockout, an alarm) must re-verify that control and update the risk management file.

title: IEC 60601-2-24: infusion pumps and controllers
text: Particular safety standard for infusion pumps: protection against over-infusion and under-infusion, bolus volume accuracy, occlusion alarm and its response time, and alarms for faults that stop delivery. Limits on bolus size and rate are protective measures and must not be bypassed by a new delivery mode.

title: FDA premarket guidance: device software functions
text: Content of premarket submissions for device software functions: a pump that can cause serious injury needs Enhanced documentation level, including software requirements, architecture, risk management file, traceability between requirements, hazards and tests, unresolved anomalies and the verification and validation results for every change.

title: DO-178C: software considerations in airborne systems
text: Software level from the failure condition: A catastrophic, B hazardous, C major. Level A has 71 objectives (many with independence). Bidirectional trace data (11.21) from system requirement to high-level and low-level requirements, source code and tests. Requirements-based tests with normal-range and robustness cases (A-6), requirements coverage and structural coverage: MC/DC for Level A (A-7).

title: ARP4754A: development of civil aircraft and systems
text: Requirements capture and validation, decomposition from aircraft function to system and item, and development assurance levels (FDAL, IDAL) assigned from failure condition severity. A change to a function's requirements must be validated and its assurance level re-checked.

title: ARP4761: safety assessment process (FHA, PSSA, SSA)
text: Functional Hazard Assessment classifies each failure condition, PSSA and SSA show the design meets its probability budget, with fault tree analysis, FMEA and common cause analysis. Changing a monitor threshold or an inhibit condition reopens the safety assessment for every failure condition that relies on it.

title: 14 CFR 25.1309 and 25.201-207: system safety and stall
text: 25.1309: catastrophic failure conditions must be extremely improbable (below 1e-9 per flight hour) and not result from a single failure; hazardous below 1e-7, major below 1e-5. 25.201, 25.203 and 25.207 cover stall demonstration, stall characteristics and stall warning. 25.672 covers stability augmentation and automatic systems.

title: AD 2020-24-02: 737 MAX return to service (MCAS lessons)
text: After the Lion Air 610 and Ethiopian 302 accidents, pitch augmentation must compare both AoA sensors and not activate if they disagree by more than 5.5 deg, activate only once per high-AoA event, keep authority the pilot can always overpower, and the AOA DISAGREE alert became standard.

title: DO-254: airborne electronic hardware design assurance
text: Design assurance for FPGAs and ASICs at levels A to E, with requirements traced down to HDL and test benches (recognized by AC 20-152A). Not covered by this software demo; it is the module Boeing asked CertusAI about.

title: DO-330: software tool qualification
text: A tool whose output is not independently verified, such as an automated gate that approves code, must be qualified at a tool qualification level set by the software level and the tool's role. Not claimed for this factory's gate.
